name: Uttar Pradesh
intro: The Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri, Varanasi's ghats and Sarnath, Lucknow's imambaras and kebabs, Krishna's Mathura and Vrindavan, Ayodhya's new Ram temple, the Sangam at Prayagraj, the Buddhist sites of Kushinagar and Shravasti, and the terai tigers of Dudhwa.

trails.name: Varanasi
trails.note: Dawn boats, aarti, Sarnath and silk.
